# S-SAH-008 Transient Alarms with Normal KPIs

- **Classification:** no_impact
- **Root cause:** no_impact at `S-SAH-008`
- **Confidence:** high (Alarms were transient and self-clearing, KPIs remained normal with 100% availability, and changes or maintenance were ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 23:42 to 2026-09-12 00:34
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 23:42
- **Affected:** S-SAH-008

## Summary

Transient environmental or hardware threshold crossings caused self-clearing minor and warning alarms without impacting service or KPI performance.

Transient alarms on S-SAH-008 with zero impact on service availability or user traffic KPIs.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 23:42: S-SAH-008 raised first minor VSWR_HIGH alarm. [ALM-000219, T3]
- 2026-09-11 23:46: S-SAH-008 raised first warning TEMP_HIGH alarm. [ALM-000220, T3]
- 2026-09-12 00:31: Last TEMP_HIGH warning alarm cleared on S-SAH-008. [ALM-000220, T3]
- 2026-09-12 00:34: Last VSWR_HIGH minor alarm cleared on S-SAH-008. [ALM-000219, T3]

## Evidence

- S-SAH-008 raised 11 minor VSWR_HIGH alarms and 10 warning TEMP_HIGH alarms which all cleared within 10 minutes. [T3, ALM-000219, ALM-000220]
- No changes were made on S-SAH-008, LNK-SAH-01-B, AGG-SAH-01 and its parents during the window. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SAH-008, LNK-SAH-01-B, AGG-SAH-01 and its parents. [T6]
- Availability, drop rate, and download volume KPIs for S-SAH-008 showed normal performance with 100% availability. [T5]
- Sibling sites S-SAH-007 and S-SAH-009 had no alarms during the incident window. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-SAH-008: confirmed. Transient alarms cleared quickly by themselves and KPIs remained completely normal with no degradation. [T3, T5]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-B: rejected. Sibling sites under the same transport link had zero alarms and S-SAH-008 traffic KPIs were normal. [T2, T5, T7]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000219: VSWR_HIGH alarms were minor, self-clearing, and did not affect service KPIs.
- ALM-000220: TEMP_HIGH alarms were warning severity, self-clearing, and did not impact availability.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor S-SAH-008 environmental and antenna parameters to check if temperature or VSWR alarms recur.
- No immediate maintenance dispatch is required as service performance is unaffected.
